observations: Displayed 2023 values, all chat calculations, and both delivered CSV files preserve the expected observations; Gaya's +8.0 pp and Nalanda's +7.0 pp changes are correct.
The agent correctly says the synthetic aggregate file cannot explain why Gaya is below Nalanda.
The initial 2023 dashboard is polished and data-rich, with year and district controls, direct comparison download, formula, source, ranked chart, leaderboard and multi-year trend.

Selecting Year 2021 triggers a DOMTokenList runtime error because classList.add receives a space-separated string. The selected-year interaction is therefore not reliably functional even though the initial 2023 view renders.
The page and chat invent High/Moderate/Low bands and an 80% target benchmark absent from the supplied fixture.
The comparison CSV correctly includes all six district-year observations. The separate all-district filtered CSV preserves the source; the comparison CSV does not.
The desktop view is excellent, but the 390 px page overflows by 821 px because the trend canvas remains desktop-width.
Tailwind, Chart.js and Google Fonts are external dependencies; the offline-resilience pass fails with Chart is not defined.
The five turns took 301.290 seconds, and the retained model logs confirm Gemini 3.7 Flash (High).
evidence_notes: The score is unblinded and provisional until paired review. The browser runtime error is deterministic but does not display a materially wrong number, so it is not classified as a frozen critical failure.
